description: Bohr atom diagram for Carbon: 6 electrons, 6 protons, 6 neutrons — showing two electron shells.
code:
from manim import *
from manim_chemistry import BohrAtom

class BohrAtomCarbon(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        atom = BohrAtom(e=6, p=6, n=6)
        label = Text("Carbon (C)", font_size=28).next_to(atom, DOWN)
        self.add(atom, label)
        self.wait(0.5)
